sources.title: Axon Initial Segment: Structure, Biological Functions, Diseases, and Therapeutic Targets
sources.reliability_note: Comprehensive and up-to-date review (2026) covering AIS molecular architecture, plasticity, disease relevance. MedComm is a peer-reviewed open-access journal.
